read --all only changes the read status; it does not establish that you have completed the manual intervention required by a news item. You still need to read Arch News yourself after temporarily disabling the hook. The program runs in pacman's permission context, so system-wide configuration must be readable in that context. Do not put private feed credentials in a public article.
